paragraphs: From Ennis Test Centre at Government Buildings, pull out and take the 1st right onto Kilrush Road.
Continue for about half a kilometre and take the next right onto Cahercalla Road.
Stay on Cahercalla Road through the quieter residential stretch, checking mirrors regularly.
At the end of Cahercalla Road, turn right onto Drumbiggle Road and follow it for about a kilometre.
Turn left into Clancy Park and follow the estate road as it bends right and then left.
Practice slow control and good observation at the junctions inside the estate.
Leaving Clancy Park, turn right onto Hermitage.
Turn right again onto Circular Road.
Take the next left onto Considine Road and follow it around to the right.
Turn right into John Paul Avenue.
Complete a U-turn on John Paul Avenue at a safe, wide spot with good visibility.
Continue back along John Paul Avenue and take the right onto Shalee Drive.
Take the next right onto Cloughleigh Road.
At the roundabout, take the 1st exit (slight left) onto Circular Road.
Turn right onto Mill Road, which continues straight onto Cornmarket Street, Carmody Street, then Clare Road.
Follow Clare Road out to Limerick Road.
At the roundabout, take the 1st exit (slight left) to stay on Limerick Road.
Turn left onto Dalcassian Drive.
At the end of the road, turn right onto Turnpike Road.
Turn left back onto Dalcassian Drive.
At the end, turn left onto Kilrush Road.
Take the right onto Cahercalla Road.
At the end, turn left onto Drumbiggle Road.
Turn left onto Golf Links Road.
At the roundabout, take the exit slight left onto the Ennis Western Relief Road.
Follow the relief road back toward the test centre and finish calmly with good mirror and signal discipline.
